title: Ocean Scene 6 — Reef Routines
purpose: Who is doing what, simple inference, and place language in one reef scene.

sentenceModels: The crab is digging in the sand.
The octopus is hiding in the cave.
The seahorse is next to the coral.
The three fish are swimming together.

adultSupport.focus: Support simple description plus light functional questions like who is hiding or who is working.
starterPrompts: How many blue fish are there?
expansionPrompts: Can you tell me which animal is next to the coral?
What might the crab find in the sand?

visualAudit: One turtle eating seaweed in the centre.
One crab digging in the sand on the left.
One octopus in a rocky cave on the right.
One seahorse beside coral and three blue fish above.
